cover.coreProposition: Long-running agent systems should separate the user-delivery plane from the model reasoning-context plane while correlating both through stable message identity and replayable metadata; local acceptance or emission is not evidence of external delivery.
cover.visualMetaphor: One luminous message capsule passing toward a human-facing window while its shadow stops before a separate reasoning chamber
cover.semanticObject: A single message with two clearly separated destinations: visible delivery and protected reasoning context
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with one dominant message object, clean separation, restrained blue and amber light, and strong thumbnail readability
